verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server, but nothing in the evidence shows native tool-calling (tools/function calls) or a reasoning parser in API requests. The only related item is a CLI --show-thinking flag that prints the reasoning block in one-shot chat. That is an adjacent CLI display option, not request-level reasoning parsing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests
